product_contract.recency: A window moves ahead of runtime fallback order only after committed selection or verified focus/readback evidence identifies that window. Remaining siblings retain runtime projection order.
product_contract.space_truth: Global and focused switcher sessions consume the same committed main-table Space topology and activation evidence.
product_contract.presentation_identity: Runtime presentation removes fallback hosts and repeated fullscreen surfaces while retaining windows with unique valid CG identity, exact binding, desktop-sibling binding, or normal desktop geometry.
product_contract.current_app_preservation: A prior committed current-app sibling remains eligible only when its binding allows activation and its CG identity is clean. A CG-only prior surface yields to a current activation-backed peer with the same normalized title.
product_contract.visible_workflow: The Noisy Option+Tab workflow exposes four user windows, presents the evidence-backed current row first in each phase, and activates the selected normal or fullscreen sibling across Spaces.

production_path: Runtime repair facts and main-table WindowRecords produce window entries with CG, AX, binding, geometry, and Space evidence.
RuntimeWindowPresentationFilter normalizes fallback, covered CG-only, and repeated fullscreen presentation surfaces.
RuntimeReadModelStore commits app-switcher and current-app payloads and may carry forward eligible prior current-app siblings.
RuntimeWindowRecencyTracker overlays committed selection or verified-focus evidence on runtime fallback order.
LiveSwitcherModel consumes committed global or focused projections, freezes the active cycle, and commits the selected activation target.
The real Space fixture exercises normal and fullscreen sibling transitions through the visible switcher and activation readback.

independent_oracle: The recency input records normal focus and then commits incognito; each recorded event determines only the matching leading row while fallback siblings keep projection order.

real_ui_diagnosis.extra_row: a prior CG-only same-title desktop host carried from the committed current-app projection

deficiency_signal.source_boundary_diagnosis: The presentation filter could not consistently distinguish strong unique user-window evidence from fullscreen noise, and current-app preservation admitted a stale CG-only surface after the current payload gained an activation-backed peer.

root_cause.recency_oracle: The prior expectation promoted a fullscreen row without a committed recency event and then selected a different row than the deterministic cycle order supplied.
root_cause.partial_projection_oracle: The prior expectation treated an app-switcher projection as a sibling-preservation source even though the committed runtime contract admits only prior current-app projection state.
root_cause.presentation_filter: Repeated-title filtering lacked one reusable strong-identity predicate, so preserving real siblings and collapsing fullscreen artifacts were decided by separate incomplete checks.
root_cause.current_app_merge: Prior activatable CG-only rows were preserved solely by activation eligibility and clean CG identity. A fullscreen transition could therefore merge a stale desktop host beside the current activation-backed surface with the same title.

semantic_delta.recency_tests: Expected order and selection now follow recorded normal focus, committed incognito selection, and runtime fallback order.
semantic_delta.projection_test: The partial current-app commit expects its one evidence-backed normal row.
semantic_delta.presentation_filter: A shared distinct-user-window predicate retains unique valid CG windows supported by exact, desktop-sibling, or normal desktop evidence while artifact filtering collapses unsupported fullscreen and fallback surfaces.
semantic_delta.current_app_preservation: A focused policy rejects a prior CG-only row when the current payload contains a different activation-backed row with the same normalized title.
semantic_delta.ui_oracle: Each real Space phase asserts the evidence-backed current-row prefix and separately proves the complete four-title set and exact target activation.
semantic_delta.structure: Title-deduplication logic moves into a 255-line focused extension; the primary presentation filter falls to 669 lines.

existing_test_clarification_gate.clarification_summary: Recency comes only from committed selection or verified focus/readback; current-app sibling preservation comes only from prior current-app projection; UI asserts the evidence-backed current-row prefix and runtime fallback order.
